recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce or edit DataElement in core for FHIR-5818; any future data-element modeling change should be handled as a new current-version StructureDefinition/ElementDefinition decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5818 was a Published FHIR-core DataElement change request asking that DataElement use ElementDefinition. Its final resolution was Considered - No action required and recorded the core-team decision not to combine DataElement and StructureDefinition because one was abstract and independent of FHIR while the other was concrete and FHIR-specific.
initial_application: No commit explicitly cites FHIR-5818. The closest implementation history is commit 91a79d84e2, made by the reporter minutes after the Jira was created, titled 'Changed DataElement to use ElementDefinition' and adding ElementDefinition-based DataElement profile sources. The later Jira no-action resolution therefore required no further keyed source change.
additional_context: Current source/build scope has moved past the original DataElement resource: source/fhir.ini comments out dataelement=DataElement, source/dataelement is absent, source/history.html records DataElement as removed and now StructureDefinition, and StructureDefinition.snapshot.element and StructureDefinition.differential.element are typed as ElementDefinition. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-5818-specific conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the current build has no active DataElement resource to update and the active replacement artifact already uses ElementDefinition.
